items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Harry James doesn't go hiring Bunny Berigan

ctx.x: Yeah. That's good. Well, let's go back a minute, because I'm also interested -- you know, since you had such a thing about trumpets and your own band. I mean, it's unusual for a top trumpet player to put real good trumpet
players in his band. You know, because generally, Harry James doesn't go hiring Bunny Berigan, or someone to sit up there and everything.
